name: tsgo-memory-repro
description: Repro: tsgo (TS7 native) keeps independent type state per checker, so shared-infrastructure generics (e.g. Panda CSS) are re-instantiated once per --checkers worker and peak RSS scales with the checker count. About memory, not speed. --checkers 1 / --singleThreaded matches tsc exactly. `npm run diag:synthetic` is the Panda-free headline.

scripts.diag:synthetic: tsc -p synthetic/tsconfig.json --extendedDiagnostics | grep -E '^Instantiations:' | sed 's/^/tsc          /'; for c in 1 2 4 8; do tsgo -p synthetic/tsconfig.json --checkers $c --extendedDiagnostics | grep -E '^Instantiations:' | sed "s/^/tsgo --checkers $c /"; done
scripts.diag:checkers: tsc -p tsconfig.json --extendedDiagnostics | grep -E '^Instantiations:' | sed 's/^/tsc          /'; for c in 1 2 4 8; do tsgo -p tsconfig.json --checkers $c --extendedDiagnostics | grep -E '^Instantiations:' | sed "s/^/tsgo --checkers $c /"; done
scripts.diag: npm run diag:ts6 && npm run diag:ts7
